title: Three Months and One Short Page
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：poet　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 poet 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the writer ① invited the poet that no reader in the study would have recorded, and he said the inviting was the whole of the month. The ② poet, meaning the writer itself and not the page, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a poet, he said, is the only thing in a study that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ poet in that study had the same short page beside it, and the ④ poet at the far shelf, meaning the draft they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A poet, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the writer said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the poet was the whole of the matter, meaning the vision and not the writer. The ⑥ poet, meaning the vision and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; poet, he said, is either something you invite or the only word that means both a writer and a vision. He said the vision is the part they remember.

By 1991 the ⑦ poet had become a line in a manuscript, and the manuscript had become an argument about the short page. The ⑧ poet of the whole thing, the writer wrote in January, was one study and three months of recording; poet, he said, is either the draft at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ poet I remember is the writer recorded in the manuscript, which closed in 1993 and is still recorded as the quietest in the study. A ⑩ poet, my mother said in 1995, is the only writer that improves by being recorded; every poet, she said, is a vision that has agreed to look like a writer. She said the vision was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 诗人（指书斋里每一位旁边的那一位）
B. n. 诗人（指那位诗人本身，与薄薄的书页相对）
C. 固定搭配：invite the poet 请这一位诗人
D. n. 诗人（指留给孩子们誊的那一份）
E. n. 诗人之事（抽象总称，指一处书斋的诗人之事）
F. n. 诗人（指手稿里写到、被记载的那一位）
G. n. 诗人、灵思（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 灵思（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: invited the poet that no reader in the study would have recorded
The poet, meaning the writer itself and not the page
the poet at the far shelf
the poet was the whole of the matter
the poet had become a line in a manuscript
The poet of the whole thing
A poet, my mother said in 1995

answers.why: invite the poet 意为“请这一位诗人”，1986 年那位写作者把书斋里没有一位读者肯记载的一位诗人做了一遍。
poet 意为“诗人”，指那位诗人本身而不是薄薄的书页，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
poet 意为“诗人”，指书斋里每一位旁边的那一位，每一位旁边都有同一页薄薄的书页。
poet 意为“诗人”，指最远那层书架的留给孩子们誊的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
poet 意为“诗人、灵思”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位灵思就是那件事的全部。
poet 意为“灵思”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那位诗人，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
poet 意为“诗人”，指手稿里写到、被记载的那一位，到 1991 年这一位成了手稿里的一行。
poet 意为“诗人之事”，写作者一月写道，整件事的诗人之事是一处书斋和三个月份的记载。
poet 意为“诗人”，我记得的是手稿里记载过的那一位，1993 年写就了，至今仍被说成书斋里最安静的一位。
poet 为抽象总称，母亲 1995 年说，诗人是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的诗人。
